page.layout: One page of index in two columns, under a centred title. Left column: chapter and verse references with page numbers to their right. Right column, separated by a vertical rule: chapter references with page numbers. Under the left column a sub-heading "AD R...".; Right-hand column of Scripture references, running down the whole height of the part, with short fragments of a column to its left. Above the column, a sub-heading "ROMANOS." Left-hand fragments "28.", "23.", "34.", "16." stand beside the rows they belong to.; Full-width heading at the top of the visible part; below it, a column of marginal references in the left margin. No running text is visible in this part.; One column of index entries on the right, with a heading "NTHIOS." above it; below, rows of entries in three columns separated by a vertical rule, and a gathering mark at the foot.
page.notes: Row alignment between the left reference column and the page-number column is inferred from line position. The lower right entries are faint and partly unreadable; those readings are marked [?]. The first line is cut at the top edge and partly unreadable; the "5" in "85" is doubtful. The "ROMANOS." heading is cut at its left edge; the first letter is not fully visible. The left-hand fragments are printed numbers from a column whose other parts are not in this image; they are placed beside their rows. The visible part shows only the heading and the left-margin references. The first reference line at the top is a fragment. The heading is visible only up to "CORI", and the reading of the first fragment is doubtful. Lower rows are read as table cells aligned by position; the cell order of the lower rows is uncertain. The leading digits of ".26. & 596. t. 26" and "t. 14. & 576. t." are not visible on the scan.
